label: class_c_06_history_01
text: Greetings, my little students. Whatever you did\nyesterday, it is now a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_02
text: Today, we will continue to unravel the marvels\nthat history has presented to us.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_03
text: I trust that you all remember our lesson before\nthe midterm exam concerning the Great Crater\r\nof Paldea and its interior—Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_04
text: This mysterious crater captured the imaginations\nof many—including the former Paldean emperor.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_05
text: Two hundred years ago, a group of explorers\nclaimed to have finally reached its depths.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_06
text: The name of the team that achieved this great\nfeat was the Area Zero Expedition.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_07
text: The team is said to have been made up of\nPaldea’s best and brightest.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_08
text: Skilled battlers, brilliant researchers—talented\nindividuals of all kinds.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_09
text: Among the list of team members was the name\nof a man who was an author and brilliant natural\r\nhistorian: [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Heath[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_10
text: After returning from the expedition to Area Zero,\nhe used his literary talent to record the events of\r\nthe expedition and publish them.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_11
text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_12
text: Let’s see if you were paying attention.\c\nWhat was the name of the team that first made it\nto the deepest reaches of the Great Crater?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_select_01
text: The Area Zero Adventurers

label: class_c_06_select_02
text: The Area Zero Expedition

label: class_c_06_select_03
text: The Area Zero Survey Corps

label: class_c_06_history_answer_01
text: Incorrect! I see that even your little head has\nbecome full of dreams of adventure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_answer_02
text: Correct! To pick up on and remember a term I\nsimply slipped into the flow of the lecture...\r\nYou really are quite the clever one.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_answer_03
text: Incorrect! Though I will admit that an expedition\nand a survey corps may take part in very\r\nsimilar activities![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_13
text: The correct name for this team was the Area\nZero Expedition![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_14
text: The record of their activities written by the\nexpedition member Heath can be found in\r\nbookstores and the like even today.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_15a
text: This record is now known as the[VAR 0xFF00(0006)] Scarlet Book[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_15b
text: This record is now known as the[VAR 0xFF00(0006)] Violet Book[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_16
text: At the time, the entire region of Paldea was\nabsolutely buzzing about Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_17a
text: The Scarlet Book was so popular that practically\neveryone had a copy.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_17b
text: The Violet Book was so popular that practically\neveryone had a copy.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_18
text:
However, the book itself was full of fantastical
descriptions and illustrations of things that could
never be thought of as real.\c
The masses began to call Heath a liar.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_19
text: Even the truth of the expedition making it to the\nbottom of the crater was called into question.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_20a
text: The Scarlet Book was condemned to the shelves\nof used bookstores as just another book of wild\r\nparanormal stories.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_20b
text: The Violet Book was condemned to the shelves\nof used bookstores as just another book of wild\r\nparanormal stories.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_21
text: There’s a copy on one of the bookshelves on the\nground floor of the entrance hall.\c\nFeel free to have a read if you’re interested.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_22
text: Oho, is that the time already? I must’ve gotten\nswept up in filling your minds with knowledge.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: class_c_06_history_23
text: This ends today’s lesson. We will unravel more of\nhistory’s enigmas together next time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
